questions.title: 01 Read an augmented row
questions.objective: Translate the augmented row into an equation in x and y.
questions.prerequisites: Read signed numbers; identify coefficients and a right-hand constant.

questions.title: 02 Complete the constant column
questions.objective: Complete the missing constant in the worked row operation.
questions.prerequisites: Multiply and subtract integers; apply an operation to all three entries.

questions.title: 03 Choose the cancelling operation
questions.objective: Eliminate x from row 2 while leaving row 1 unchanged.
questions.prerequisites: Read the destination of a row-operation arrow; find an additive inverse.

questions.title: 04 Explain reversibility
questions.objective: Choose the reverse operation that recovers the original system.
questions.prerequisites: Read an old and new row; understand that a system requires both equations.

questions.title: 05 Repair the first row error
questions.objective: Find the first incorrect line, then correct the value of y.
questions.prerequisites: Follow a labelled calculation; distinguish the constant from the coefficients.

questions.title: 06 Solve a fresh system
questions.objective: Choose the pair that solves both original equations.
questions.prerequisites: Read an augmented matrix; use exact fractions; check a pair by substitution.
